messages.subject: Slider size
parts:
All,

I wonder whether there is a straightforward way to increase the size of a slider: both the dimensions and the font size of the labels.  I am aware that, when inserted into ui.R, the code below can change the width of the slider:

tags$head(
  tags$style(type="text/css", ".jslider{ max-width: 80%; }")
)


but I really want the font sizes to be bigger so that the labels are easier to see.  After poking around the file jquery.slider.min.css, I tried to add the following to ui.R:


tags$head(
  tags$style(type="text/css", ".jslider{ font-size: 12px; }")
)


but did not get anywhere with this strategy.

Thanks,
Ed

messages.author: 4be88a5fc86a040f
messages.subject: Re: Slider size
parts:
To change min-max labels:
".jslider .jslider-label{font-size: 12px;}"

To change current value (values if it's a range slider)
".jslider .jslider-value{font-size: 12px;}"
